name: Ingrid Lindgren
headline: 34-year-old owner of a boutique hotel, caring for her mother in Stockholm, Sweden
title: Fika Invitation from an Old Friend
situation: Ingrid's phone buzzes with a text from Karin, a friend from her Uppsala childhood who now lives abroad. Karin is in Stockholm for the day and suggests meeting for fika at a café near Gamla Stan. Ingrid has no pressing meetings, and her mother is calmly reading in the courtyard. The night nurse will arrive at 9 p.m., so she has a few hours free. She considers whether to accept the invitation or politely decline to continue reviewing her hotel expansion estimates.

context.relationship_profiles: Karin was Ingrid's closest friend in secondary school; they now meet only during Karin's infrequent visits to Stockholm.
context.tendencies: Ingrid often continues working during free evenings, but she once canceled a contractor meeting to see Karin. She usually prioritizes her mother's schedule over last-minute plans.
context.current_state: Ingrid's shoulders are tight from hours hunched over financial estimates. Her mother is quietly reading in the courtyard. She has no pressing meetings, but the expansion estimates still need another pass.
context.immediate_memories: Karin's name on the phone brings back skipping class together by the river in Uppsala. The café reminds her of the almond pastry they shared on Karin's last visit.
context.reflective_memories: Ingrid remembers that Karin never asked about her inheritance, and their conversations felt separate from her hotel life. She also recalls her mother telling her that youth friendships are worth preserving.
